name: Firetap Knowledge Panel Schema
author: FireTap Ltd

sections.description:
Firetap Knowledge Panel Schema helps firms, agencies, consultants, local businesses, and publishers manage structured data and search presentation from one plugin.

Instead of juggling separate tools for business schema, FAQs, reviews, video SEO, validation, and page-level overrides, the plugin brings those workflows into one admin experience.

Version 2.8.1 focuses on a cleaner professional SEO workflow with:

  • a unified FireTap SEO panel for page-level search, schema, overrides, AI FAQs, and AI visibility checks
  • editable SEO title, meta description, focus keyphrase, and Google-style search preview controls
  • AI title, meta description, and FAQ generation using supported providers
  • schema health monitoring, validation tools, and a live URL inspector
  • duplicate and missing-property warnings to reduce markup risk
  • citation-ready answer blocks and source attribution features for trust-focused pages
  • reusable schema templates, advanced conditions, presets, and entity linking
  • import/export packs, white-label admin options, permissions, and snapshot rollback tools
  • support for business, local, article, service, product, review, FAQ, video, and other common schema types
  • modern FAQ, review, and video presentation features so schema-managed content also works well on-page

This plugin is designed for organisations that want stronger technical SEO, better content workflows, and more control over structured data at scale.

Step-By-Step Setup Guide

1. Set Up Your Business Or Brand Schema

Go to KPSP Schema > Settings and complete your main organisation details first:

  • business name
  • website URL
  • logo
  • phone number
  • contact type
  • language
  • social profile URLs
  • business type
  • local business details such as address, geo, opening hours, and area served

Why this matters:
This creates the core entity data that supports brand consistency, local SEO, and stronger Knowledge Panel signals.

2. Build Reusable Schema Templates

Go to KPSP Schema > Templates and create templates for the page types you use most often.

Good starter examples:

  • Service template for service pages
  • Article template for blog posts
  • FAQ template for guide pages
  • Product template for product or package pages
  • Video template for video landing pages

Then assign display conditions such as:

  • post type
  • category
  • tag
  • taxonomy term
  • page template
  • author
  • meta key
  • featured image
  • specific post or URL match

Why this matters:
Templates let firms scale structured data across many pages without rebuilding markup page by page.

3. Use The Dashboard And URL Inspector

Go to KPSP Schema > Dashboard to review schema health across the site.

Use it to check:

  • schema coverage
  • warnings
  • missing required fields
  • duplicate or conflicting nodes
  • detected schema types

Then open KPSP Schema > Validation to inspect a live URL and review the generated graph in more detail.

Why this matters:
This helps teams catch technical SEO problems before they become larger sitewide issues.

4. Create FAQ Groups

Go to FAQ Groups and create a reusable FAQ set.

You can:

  • add questions and answers manually
  • choose a front-end layout
  • set colours, spacing, typography, icons, and display variants
  • control FAQ schema output

Place the FAQ group where needed using the shortcode shown in the editor, for example:

[faq_group id="123"]

Why this matters:
FAQ Groups help firms turn helpful service or sales questions into reusable content blocks that also support FAQ schema.

5. Optimise Search Appearance On Individual Pages

Edit any page or post and open the FireTap SEO panel.

Use the Search tab to manage:

  • focus keyphrase
  • SEO title
  • meta description
  • Google-style preview

Recommended workflow:

  1. Open the Search tab.
  2. Review the live preview.
  3. Edit the SEO title manually or click Generate SEO Title.
  4. Edit the meta description manually or click Generate Meta Description.
  5. Save the page.

Why this matters:
It gives firms a cleaner way to manage title and description quality directly in the editor while reusing the same AI setup already configured for FAQs.

6. Use AI FAQ Generation On Individual Pages

Edit any page or post and open the FireTap SEO panel, then switch to the AI FAQs tab.

Recommended workflow:

  1. Enable AI FAQs on that page.
  2. Choose the language style such as British English or American English.
  3. Choose whether approved FAQs should display on the page.
  4. Choose whether approved FAQs should output FAQ schema.
  5. Click Generate FAQs From This Page.
  6. Review each generated FAQ.
  7. Mark each item as Approved, Pending, or Rejected.
  8. Save the page.

If you use Divi, Elementor, or another builder and want precise placement, paste this shortcode where you want the approved AI FAQs to appear:

[kpsp_page_ai_faq]

Why this matters:
This gives firms a faster way to draft relevant FAQs while keeping full admin approval before anything goes live.

7. Add AI Visibility And Trust Signals

Edit any page or post and open the FireTap SEO panel, then switch to AI Visibility.

You can configure:

  • citation-ready answer block
  • answer block title
  • answer block summary
  • answer block position
  • source attribution block
  • author name and URL
  • reviewer name and URL
  • last updated date
  • citation links
  • about entity
  • reviewed-by entity

Why this matters:
This helps firms publish clearer answer summaries and stronger trust signals on pages where authority and credibility matter most.

8. Add Reviews

Go to Review Groups and create a review set for the relevant service, location, or landing page.

You can:

  • add reviews manually
  • import or paste reviews
  • choose display layouts such as cards, grid, list, slider, badge, or quotes
  • show ratings, avatars, CTAs, replies, excerpts, and highlights
  • output review schema

Why this matters:
Review Groups help firms show proof, trust, and conversion-focused content in a reusable format.

9. Create Video Pages

Go to Videos and add a new video page.

Complete the main fields:

  • video title
  • video URL or embed URL
  • thumbnail
  • upload date
  • duration
  • description
  • transcript

Then choose a layout template and branding settings.

You can also:

  • choose where the title, description, transcript, and FAQs should appear
  • use global video branding or override styles per video
  • control title size, colours, spacing, borders, and page width
  • add a custom back button label and link from the main settings

Why this matters:
This helps firms publish more polished video landing pages that are useful for both users and search engines.

10. Add FAQs To Video Pages

Inside each video entry you now have two ways to add FAQs:

  • add Video FAQs directly inside the dedicated FAQ editor
  • paste a normal FAQ Group shortcode into the Video FAQ shortcode field

When using the shortcode field, you can choose where FAQs appear in the video layout, such as:

  • below the player
  • beside the player
  • below the content area
  • sidebar

Why this matters:
This gives teams flexibility to use either dedicated video FAQs or their existing reusable FAQ Groups on video landing pages.

11. Use Rich HTML Editing Where Needed

The plugin now supports richer editing in key areas.

Examples:

  • AI FAQ answers use the WordPress editor
  • video transcript uses the WordPress editor
  • video FAQ answers support HTML-capable editing
  • video description can process shortcode content

Why this matters:
This makes it much easier to add links, formatting, and more polished content without losing control.

12. Export, Import, And Reuse Configurations

Go to KPSP Schema > Settings for pack export and import tools.

Use this when you want to:

  • move settings between staging and live sites
  • reuse templates across client projects
  • standardise delivery across similar firms or campaigns

Why this matters:
Agencies and multi-site teams can save time by reusing successful schema and content setups.

13. Use Permissions And White-Label Options

From the settings area, configure:

  • white-label branding
  • role-safe access to Dashboard, Templates, Entities, Validation, and Settings

Why this matters:
This helps agencies give clients a cleaner interface without exposing every advanced control.

14. Save Snapshot History Before Big Changes

The plugin stores snapshots before major template, entity, settings, and import actions.

Use this when:

  • testing a new schema structure
  • changing reusable templates
  • importing data from another site
  • updating client configurations

Why this matters:
Rollback support reduces risk when you make bigger technical SEO or content-structure changes.

Quick Start By Goal

If You Want Better Local SEO

  1. Complete your business and local settings.
  2. Add geo, area served, and opening hours.
  3. Create LocalBusiness or service templates.
  4. Validate the output in the dashboard and URL inspector.

If You Want Better FAQ Coverage

  1. Create reusable FAQ Groups.
  2. Open the FireTap SEO panel and use the AI FAQs tab on important service and landing pages.
  3. Review and approve only the useful items.
  4. Place approved AI FAQs with [kpsp_page_ai_faq] when using builders.

If You Want Better Search Snippets

  1. Open the FireTap SEO panel on the target page.
  2. Use the Search tab to review the Google-style preview.
  3. Generate or refine the SEO title.
  4. Generate or refine the meta description.
  5. Save and publish the page.

If You Want Better AI Search Visibility

  1. Open the FireTap SEO panel on important service or article pages.
  2. Add a citation-ready answer block.
  3. Add source attribution details and citation links.
  4. Check bot access and AI visibility status in the dashboard.
  5. Use the URL inspector to review the live page output.

If You Want Better Video SEO

  1. Create a video page in Videos.
  2. Complete the thumbnail, description, and transcript.
  3. Add Video FAQs or a FAQ Group shortcode.
  4. Choose the layout positions and branding settings.
  5. Check the live page and video sitemap.

If You Want Better Agency Workflow

  1. Create templates and presets once.
  2. Export packs for reuse.
  3. Use permissions and white-label settings.
  4. Review diagnostics from the dashboard before handoff.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.

Technical Notes

The Contributors: field lists WordPress.org usernames to properly attribute development and link profiles in the plugin directory.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Open KPSP Schema in the WordPress admin
  4. Configure your business schema, templates, FAQ, reviews, videos, and AI FAQ settings
  5. Save changes
  6. If video pages were just enabled, save Permalinks once to refresh rewrites
sections.faq:
Will this create duplicate FAQ markup?

The plugin includes duplicate protection in multiple places. FAQ Groups can be controlled per page, schema nodes can be checked in validation tools, and approved AI FAQs now merge with existing plugin FAQ shortcodes on the same page instead of creating a second duplicate block.

Can firms approve AI FAQs before they go live?

Yes. AI-generated FAQs are created for review first. Each item can be marked approved, pending, or rejected before it is shown on the page or output in schema.

Can I use British English, American English, or other languages?

Yes. The AI FAQ generator includes British English, American English, and a wider language list so firms can create market-appropriate FAQ content.

Can I place AI FAQs manually inside Divi, Elementor, or other builders?

Yes. Use [kpsp_page_ai_faq] on the same page to place approved AI FAQs exactly where you want them.

Can I use cloud AI providers instead of a local model?

Yes. Version 2.8.1 supports local and cloud AI workflows, including Ollama, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, and Perplexity-based setups.

Can agencies reuse settings across client sites?

Yes. Version 2.8.1 includes schema pack import/export plus white-label and permission controls to support agency workflows.

Where do I put FAQs on video pages?

You can either add dedicated Video FAQs inside the video editor or paste a normal FAQ Group shortcode into the video FAQ shortcode field. The video layout settings let you choose where that FAQ block should appear on the page.

Can I add links inside video transcripts and FAQs?

Yes. Version 2.8.1 adds richer HTML-capable editing to video transcripts, video FAQs, and AI FAQ answers so you can include links and formatting more easily.
sections.changelog:
2.8.1

  • Added unified FireTap SEO editor panel for pages and posts
  • Added Search tab with focus keyphrase, SEO title, meta description, and live Google-style preview
  • Added AI-generated SEO title and meta description using the configured AI provider
  • Added AI Visibility tab with citation-ready answer blocks and source attribution controls
  • Added AI visibility audit and bot access checker for major search and AI crawlers
  • Added dedicated Video FAQs with HTML-capable answers and live front-end FAQ rendering on video pages
  • Upgraded video transcript editing to use a proper WordPress HTML editor so links and richer formatting can be added
  • Added video page spacing controls for title-to-video, stacked sections, hero columns, and content columns
  • Added dedicated video FAQ shortcode placement controls so FAQ Groups can be positioned on video pages
  • Added global video back button text and link controls in settings
  • Unified the page-level AI FAQ workflow into the main FireTap SEO editor
  • Improved AI response handling for FAQ and search generation workflows
  • Expanded the readme with a clear step-by-step setup guide and feature usage walkthrough

2.8

  • Added schema health dashboard and live URL inspector
  • Added duplicate and missing-property diagnostics
  • Added import/export packs, snapshot history, rollback, white-label branding, and feature permissions
  • Expanded template engine with presets, richer conditions, token mapping, and entity relationships
  • Added QAPage, HowTo, and Dataset support
  • Added commerce and local defaults including merchant, geo, area served, and opening-hours support
  • Added Merchant Product Pro and Location Page Pro starter templates
  • Added modern video layouts plus global and per-video branding controls for typography, colours, borders, shadows, player radius, and width
  • Added AI FAQ generation with local and cloud AI provider support, automatic model selection, admin approval workflow, expanded language selection, builder shortcode placement, rich answer editing, on-page output, and duplicate-aware FAQ merging
  • Expanded Review Groups with richer imported review fields including source, avatar, reply, highlight, hide controls, filters, and modern widget layouts
  • Expanded FAQ Groups with more modern display controls including style variants, icon options, grid columns, search, spacing, and first-open behaviour

2.7

  • Added templates, entities, conditions, validation, and post-level overrides while keeping existing KPSP settings and output intact
  • Added reusable schema templates with mapping, conditions, preview, and validation
  • Added advanced schema support for Person, Brand, Article, Service, Review, Recipe, VideoObject, Event, JobPosting, Book, SoftwareApplication, Podcast, Movie, and VehicleListing
  • Added FAQ Groups with multiple display styles, WYSIWYG answers, color controls, hex inputs, and reusable global FAQ styling
  • Added Review Groups with manual entry, import support, source tracking, and review schema output
  • Added public Videos post type with metadata detection, broader video provider support, custom video details editing, standalone video pages, VideoObject schema, SEO schema integration, and /video-sitemap.xml output
  • Added entity linking for Organization, Person, and Brand using reusable @id nodes
  • Added per-post schema override metabox for disabling templates or injecting custom JSON-LD
  • Added duplicate protection for appended schema nodes
  • Updated plugin admin styling and kept the original main settings experience available for safe upgrades
  • Preserved legacy kpsp_* options and existing 2.6 schema output for safe upgrades

2.6

  • Fixed location fields not saving correctly in admin
  • Fixed locations option mismatch (locations to kpsp_locations)
  • Improved location sanitisation and reliability
  • Improved live JSON preview accuracy
  • General stability and admin improvements

2.5

  • Added Course schema support
  • Added Product image upload with logo fallback
  • Added URL targeting for FAQs, Products, and Courses
  • Fixed Product rich results validation
  • Improved schema output consistency
